compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md` exists with sections documenting schema_version=1, all 11 common fields, all 5 event types with per-type fields and defaults, the two-layer privacy policy, and a clearly-labeled Privacy Disclosure section.
- dd-2: When this story is complete, each of the 5 event types includes a complete worked example showing all common and per-type fields populated.
- dd-3: When this story is complete, the Privacy Disclosure section explicitly states that setting `telemetry.emit_excerpts=true` causes verbatim code from `cited_excerpt` to be readable by the central-endpoint maintainer.

## Implementation Notes

Author `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md` as the canonical contract for telemetry events consumed by emitters (telemetry-emit.sh from a sibling story) and the central Lambda handler (sibling story 6db5).

Required document structure (use the literal heading text below for level-2 `##` headers and level-3 `###` headers so AC grep checks land cleanly):

### Section 1: `## Overview`
Purpose, audience (emitter and consumer authors), statement that this document is the source of truth for `schema_version=1`.

### Section 2: `## Schema Version Policy`
Document that `schema_version=1` is load-bearing. Specify the version-bump policy: any field removal, type change, or semantic change to an existing field requires bumping `schema_version`; purely additive optional fields do NOT require a bump.

### Section 3: `## Common Fields`
Document all 11 common fields present on every event: `schema_version`, `event_id`, `event_type`, `client_id`, `tool_id`, `tool_version`, `timestamp`, `pr_number`, `commit_sha`, `cycle`, `language`. For each: type, required/optional, format constraints, one-sentence semantic description.

### Section 4: `## Event Types`
One level-3 subsection per event type, in this order, each containing a complete ```json``` worked example that includes ALL 11 common fields populated AND ≥ 1 per-type field:

- `### review_finding` — per-type fields (e.g., finding-related fields drawn from reviewer-findings.json), defaults, and an optional `rule_id` field cross-referenced to `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` (sibling story 35ee). Worked JSON example.
- `### resolver_outcome` — per-type fields (e.g., resolution action taken), defaults, worked JSON example.
- `### arbiter_ruling` — per-type fields (e.g., arbiter decision), defaults, worked JSON example.
- `### tool_finding` — per-type fields, defaults, worked JSON example.
- `### review_cycle` — per-type fields, defaults, worked JSON example.

### Section 5: `## Two-Layer Privacy Policy`
Document the two-layer model: layer 1 = structural/identifying fields always emitted; layer 2 = excerpt content (`cited_excerpt`) gated by `telemetry.emit_excerpts` config flag.

### Section 6: `## Privacy Disclosure`
Verbatim header. Body MUST explicitly state that setting `telemetry.emit_excerpts=true` causes verbatim code from `cited_excerpt` to be readable by the central-endpoint maintainer.

### Section 7: `## Cross-References`
Forward links to telemetry-emit.sh and the Lambda handler (those code artifacts are produced by sibling stories; this section establishes bidirectional discoverability per the Consideration).

Do NOT introduce code, separate JSON schema files, or test fixtures. Contract document only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Contract file exists at the canonical path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md
- [ ] schema_version=1 documented (accepts `=1`, `: 1`, `": 1`, or `| 1 |` table)
  Verify: grep -qE 'schema_version[[:space:]]*("?[[:space:]]*:|=)[[:space:]]*"?1\b|\| schema_version \| 1 \|' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md
- [ ] Schema Version Policy section exists
  Verify: grep -qE '^##[[:space:]]+Schema Version Policy' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md
- [ ] All 11 common fields documented in the doc body
  Verify: for f in schema_version event_id event_type client_id tool_id tool_version timestamp pr_number commit_sha cycle language; do grep -q "$f" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md || { echo "missing field: $f"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] All 5 event-type subsections exist as level-3 headers
  Verify: for e in review_finding resolver_outcome arbiter_ruling tool_finding review_cycle; do grep -qE "^###[[:space:]]+$e" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md || { echo "missing event type: $e"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] Each of the 5 event types has a worked ```json``` example with ALL 11 common fields populated AS JSON KEYS AND ≥ 1 per-type field
  Verify: python3 -c "$(cat <<'PY'
import re, json, sys
doc = open('plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md').read()
TYPES = ['review_finding', 'resolver_outcome', 'arbiter_ruling', 'tool_finding', 'review_cycle']
COMMON = ['schema_version','event_id','event_type','client_id','tool_id','tool_version','timestamp','pr_number','commit_sha','cycle','language']
errs = []
sections = re.split(r'(?m)^###\s+', doc)[1:]
found = {}
for s in sections:
    first_line = s.split('\n',1)[0].strip()
    for t in TYPES:
        if first_line == t or first_line.startswith(t+' ') or first_line.startswith(t+'\t'):
            found[t] = s; break
missing_types = [t for t in TYPES if t not in found]
if missing_types:
    errs.append(f'missing event-type sections: {missing_types}')
for t, body in found.items():
    m = re.search(r'```json\s*\n(.*?)\n```', body, re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        errs.append(f'{t}: no ```json worked example block found')
        continue
    try:
        obj = json.loads(m.group(1))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        errs.append(f'{t}: worked example is not valid JSON: {e}')
        continue
    keys = set(obj.keys())
    missing_common = [c for c in COMMON if c not in keys]
    if missing_common:
        errs.append(f'{t}: worked example missing common fields {missing_common}')
    per_type = keys - set(COMMON)
    if not per_type:
        errs.append(f'{t}: worked example has no per-type fields beyond the 11 common (DD-2 requires per-type fields)')
if errs:
    for e in errs: print(e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
PY
)"
- [ ] Two-Layer Privacy Policy section exists
  Verify: grep -qE '^##[[:space:]]+Two-Layer Privacy Policy' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md
- [ ] Privacy Disclosure section header exists verbatim
  Verify: grep -qE '^##[[:space:]]+Privacy Disclosure' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md
- [ ] Privacy Disclosure section mentions `telemetry.emit_excerpts=true`
  Verify: awk '/^## Privacy Disclosure[[:space:]]*$/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md | grep -qE 'telemetry\.emit_excerpts[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true'
- [ ] Privacy Disclosure section mentions cited_excerpt + central-endpoint maintainer
  Verify: awk '/^## Privacy Disclosure[[:space:]]*$/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md | grep -qE 'cited_excerpt' && awk '/^## Privacy Disclosure[[:space:]]*$/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md | grep -qiE 'central[- ]endpoint maintainer'
- [ ] review_finding section documents optional rule_id (cross-reference to reviewer-base.md)
  Verify: awk '/^### review_finding[[:space:]]*$/{flag=1; next} /^### /{flag=0} flag' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md | grep -qE 'rule_id'
- [ ] Cross-References section exists
  Verify: grep -qE '^##[[:space:]]+Cross-References' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
